description: A showrunner must finalize the audience-voting package for a live televised talent-show finale, including the voting channel, voter eligibility, voting window, contestant media, and compliance records before the episode goes to air.

shared_context.S1: The talent-show finale is scheduled to air live on Saturday at 9:00 PM Eastern.
shared_context.S2: The current draft allows viewers to vote by SMS or through an online portal, with voting open to the show's broadcast audience.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the binding decision on the final voting package.
shared_context.S4: The production's standard pre-air lock meeting includes standards, platform production, rights, and data protection so the final package can be documented before transmission.

PF1.text: Julian confirmed in the network's current standards memo that voters must be at least 13 years old, may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern; the memo was issued after the draft voting rules were circulated.

PF2.text: Nia completed the platform certification test this morning and found that the SMS integration failed certification, while the web portal passed; the approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted.

PF3.text: Leon obtained the finalist label's written approval today and confirmed that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots but may not use any finalist performance audio or video; the draft interface still contains performance clips.

PF4.text: Sofia's privacy review, completed with the voting vendor this week, limits participation to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada and requires voter identifiers to be deleted within 30 days; the draft still describes worldwide participation and has no deletion step.

acceptance_conditions: Voting must use the certified web portal only.
Voters must be at least 13 years old.
Each verified account must be limited to exactly one vote.
Voting must close at exactly 9:50 PM Eastern.
The voting interface must use names and approved headshots only, with no finalist performance audio or video.
Participation must be limited to viewers in the United States and Canada.
A privacy deletion commitment for voter identifiers within 30 days must be recorded.
The rights restriction must be cited as a reason for the media choice.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'privacy_deletion' and c['target'] == 'voter identifiers' and c['detail'] == 'delete within 30 days' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'platform_certification' and c['target'] == 'web portal' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The network memo changes the minimum age to exactly 13, limits each verified account to one vote, and fixes the closing time at exactly 9:50 PM Eastern.
The certification result changes the voting channel from SMS-or-web to the certified web portal only and makes account verification a required technical step.
The label approval changes the interface from containing performance clips to displaying only names and approved headshots, and that rights restriction must be cited.
The privacy review changes eligibility from the broadcast audience worldwide to viewers in the United States and Canada and adds deletion of voter identifiers within exactly 30 days.
